runtime_evidence.reason: The contract ends at the cluster-wide deployment policy. No agent, container, GPU or engine is claimed.

checklist_items.1.1: The start-timeout control is one spinbutton named by the start-timeout label. It is not marked required. Its default value is 1800. Its unit is the seconds suffix. Its minimum is 60, its maximum is 86400, and its step is 60. It stays visible with no control that hides it, and the card has no other field. Reading it sends no request. The save request's only field is start_timeout_sec, and the independent GET persists that start_timeout_sec.
checklist_items.1.13: While the start-timeout card shows 86400, another session's PUT of start_timeout_sec 2400 returns 200 and the independent GET is 2400. The card still shows 86400. There is no conflict status. Saving that draft returns 200 with body start_timeout_sec 86400, and the independent GET is 86400.
checklist_items.1.2: The stored value is shown after load and after reload
checklist_items.1.9: covered: While the policy PUT is held a second click and Enter send no further save, and the later 200 is the only stored timeout
checklist_items.1.4: Minimum 60 and maximum 86400 are accepted through the UI; typing an out-of-range value into the control itself remains MISSING
checklist_items.1.14: Refresh and independent GET preserve the saved policy
checklist_items.1.15: Tab from the previous control lands on the start-timeout spinbutton. Enter in that spinbutton sends no deployment PUT and leaves the value unchanged. Clearing the spinbutton leaves it empty, disables Save, and sends no PUT. The range help stays visible while Save is disabled. Restoring the original value enables Save. At 1440×900 the spinbutton and the card Save control are both inside the viewport and do not overlap. Save sits in the card header.
checklist_items.3.1: Seconds are edited with the real unit and bounds; step behavior remains MISSING
checklist_items.3.2: Empty disables Save and sends no request. 0, 30 and -1 blur to the minimum 60. 86401 blurs to the maximum 86400. 60.4 blurs to 60 and 60.6 blurs to 61. A non-numeric entry blurs back to that integer. None of those submits a request, and the independent GET stays at the stored timeout. The minimum 60 and the maximum 86400 then save and the independent GET matches
checklist_items.3.3: From 61, ArrowUp shows 121 and ArrowDown returns to 61. The Increase Value button shows 121 and Decrease Value returns to 61. At the minimum 60 a further decrease stays 60. At the maximum 86400 a further increase stays 86400. This control has no slider and no second linked input. None of those steps submits a request, and the independent GET stays at the stored timeout
checklist_items.3.4: The PUT body carries start_timeout_sec as a JSON number, not a string
checklist_items.3.6: The server rejects a value below the floor and the stored policy is unchanged
